item.title: AI Coding Agent Pricing: Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot Plans and Prices (November 2026)
item.description:
AI Coding Agent Pricing: Claude Code, Codex and GitHub Copilot (November 2026)

Short answer: the cheapest paid plans are $10 (Copilot Pro), $17 to $20 (Claude Pro) and $20 (ChatGPT Plus, which includes Codex). The top tiers are $100 to $200 a month. Every price below was read from the vendor’s own pricing page on 2026-11-25. Prices can change, so check the page before you buy.

Plan prices and limits

item.title: AI Memory Pricing 2026: Mem0, Zep, Supermemory, Hindsight
item.description:
Which memory products cost what?

Agent memory pricing comes in three shapes: a free tier with monthly limits, a fixed monthly plan with credits, and pay-per-use billing. As of 11 November 2026, Hindsight is the only one of the four with no plan fee. You pay for what you use on its Cloud, or nothing beyond your own servers if you self-host.

Price table

Prices and limits as shown on each vendor’s pricing page, read on 11 November 2026.
